meta.title: Chromata Library Reference
meta.description: Path-tracing visual effects library for images

data_flow: 3. Image converted to flat Uint8Array pixelData[(row*w+col)*4+ch]
5. Animation loop: pathfinders read pixels, calculate next position
architecture.pathfinder_algorithm: Samples arc ahead (turningAngle width, sampleSize divisions), finds pixel with best color match based on key (low=bright, high=dark), avoids visited pixels via workingArray, bounces at canvas edges

Chromata.description: Loads images, manages animation loop, coordinates pathfinders and renderers

methods.constructor(imageElement, options): Initialize canvases, load image, merge options
methods.reset(): Clear canvas, reset workingArray, remove render canvas
methods._mergeOptions(options): Merge user config with defaults, validate ranges
methods._appendRenderCanvas(): Hide source image, insert render canvas into DOM
methods._removeRenderCanvas(): Show source image, remove render canvas
methods._run(): Initialize PRNG, pathfinders, renderers; start fixed-timestep tick loop
methods.exportSVG(): Collect SVG paths from all renderers, return complete SVG document string
methods.getStats(): Return {iterations, fps, pathfinders} for monitor display
methods._initPathFinders(): Create pathfinder array based on origins

PathFinder.description: Determines next pixel to visit based on color matching and direction

methods.constructor(pixelData, workingData, widt: Initialize with flat typed arrays, dimensions, position, target color
methods.getNextPoint(): Main entry - get next coordinate, retry up to 5 times if not pristine
methods._getNextPixel(): Core algorithm - sample arc, find best match, update position
methods.getColor(): Return target color as {r, g, b}
methods._getVelocityAngle(): Calculate direction angle, handle edge bouncing
methods._hexToRgb(hex): Convert hex color to [r, g, b] array
methods._getColorDistance(pixel): Calculate distance from pixel to target color
methods._isInRange(x, y): Check if coordinates are within canvas bounds
methods._getRgbIndex(targetColorArray): Determine which RGB channel to track

PathRenderer.description: Renders paths as smooth curves, straight lines, or dots

methods.constructor(context, pathFinder, options: Setup canvas context, get pathfinder color, init SVG recording (svgPath, svgCircles)
methods.drawNextLine(): Dispatch to appropriate draw method based on lineMode
methods._drawLineSmooth(): Quadratic bezier curves with gradient + SVG Q commands
methods._drawLineSquare(): Straight line segments with gradient + SVG L commands
methods._getStrokeColor(colorValue): Generate RGBA string based on colorMode and opacity

PathQueue.description: Fixed-size queue for remembering recent path positions

methods.put(item): Add item, discard oldest if over size
methods.get(index): Retrieve by index (positive from start, negative from end)
methods.contains(item): Check if point exists in queue

Utils.description: Helper functions for image processing and setup

methods._indexToRgbString(i): Assign RGB color to pathfinder (cycles red/green/blue)
methods._getPixelData(sourceContext): Return flat Uint8Array copy of canvas pixel data
methods._getWorkingData(sourceContext): Return zeroed Uint8Array(width*height*3) for visit tracking
methods._getOutputDimensions(image, size): Calculate output dimensions based on size option

ImageProcessor.description: Edge detection and blending for sketch effects

colorMode.description: RGB color cycling vs monochrome output

key.description: low = seek bright pixels, high = seek dark pixels

lineMode.description: smooth = curves, square = straight lines, point = dots

outputSize.description: Use original image size or fit to container

turningAngle.description: Arc width for direction sampling. π/8=22.5°, π/4=45°, π/2=90°, π=180°, 2π=360°

sampleSize.description: Directions tested within turning arc. Higher = smoother paths, lower = angular/choppy

jitter.description: Random wobble for hand-drawn feel. Applied as: theta += (random-0.5) * jitter * π

edgeDetect.description: Sobel edge detection mix. 0=original, 0.5=blended, 1=pure edges. Critical for sketch effects

stepsPerFrame.description: Decouples visual speed from tracing accuracy. Each animation frame, pathfinders take this many steps. speed=3 + stepsPerFrame=6 gives visual rate of 18px/frame with 3px tracing precision.

pathMemory.description: PathQueue size - points remembered for backtracking

alphaThreshold.description: Minimum alpha value for pathfinders to visit a pixel. 255=only fully opaque (default), 1=skip only fully transparent, 128=reasonable threshold for anti-aliased edges. Use lower values to trace images with transparency without coloring transparent background.

seed.description: Seed for reproducible renders. null=random (Math.random), any integer=deterministic output via mulberry32 PRNG. Same seed + same settings = identical output every time.

architecture_changes_v2.delta_time: Fixed-timestep accumulator (16.67ms steps) ensures consistent simulation speed across 60Hz/120Hz/144Hz displays. Movement is identical regardless of frame rate.
architecture_changes_v2.typed_arrays: pixelArray and workingArray replaced with flat Uint8Array. pixelData[(row*width+col)*4+channel] replaces pixelArray[row][col][channel]. Eliminates ~800K small array allocations for a 1000x800 image.
architecture_changes_v2.seeded_prng: mulberry32 PRNG replaces Math.random() in jitter calculations when seed is provided. Passes BigCrush statistical test.
architecture_changes_v2.svg_recording: PathRenderer records SVG path commands (M/Q/L) and circle coordinates during drawing. exportSVG() collects all renderer paths into a complete SVG document.
architecture_changes_v2.fps_tracking: Smoothed FPS (exponential moving average, 0.9 weight) calculated from frame timestamps in _tick().
architecture_changes_v2.tweakpane_ui: Tweakpane v4 replaces manual HTML controls. Folders: Controls, Presets (built-in + user saved), Display, Path Finders, Origins, Export, Monitor.
architecture_changes_v2.export_suite: PNG (canvas.toDataURL), WebM video (MediaRecorder + captureStream), SVG vector (exportSVG method)

lines.description: Vertical lines from top and bottom

improvement_ideas.name: Line Pressure/Taper
improvement_ideas.description: Vary line width along path - start thick, taper to thin for natural brush/pen feel
improvement_ideas.implementation: Modify PathRenderer to track path length and adjust lineWidth progressively

improvement_ideas.name: Paper Texture Overlay
improvement_ideas.description: Optional grain/texture layer composited over final render
improvement_ideas.implementation: Load texture PNG, composite with multiply blend after animation completes

improvement_ideas.name: Canny Edge Detection
improvement_ideas.description: More sophisticated than Sobel - includes Gaussian blur and hysteresis thresholding
improvement_ideas.implementation: Add CannyDetector to ImageProcessor with configurable thresholds

improvement_ideas.name: Multi-Pass Rendering
improvement_ideas.description: Run multiple passes with different settings for layered effects
improvement_ideas.implementation: Queue of Chromata configs, render sequentially without clearing canvas

improvement_ideas.name: Custom Origin Patterns
improvement_ideas.description: Spiral, grid, radial burst, edge-following seed patterns

improvement_ideas.name: Animation Recording
improvement_ideas.implementation: Frame capture with MediaRecorder API or gif.js library

improvement_ideas.name: Color Palette Extraction
improvement_ideas.description: Auto-extract dominant colors from image for pathfinder targets
improvement_ideas.implementation: K-means clustering on pixel colors, replace Utils._indexToRgbString()

pencil_sketch.why_it_works: Edge detection makes paths follow contours. Jitter adds natural wobble. Multiple origins create cross-hatching. Darken composite builds up like pencil strokes. Thin lines with low opacity layer naturally.
